---
title: "Code Quality"
---

The agent keeps slipping `print()` into production modules instead of using your logger, and bare `except:` clauses show up under deadline pressure. You want layered feedback. A fast advisory fires on every edit, a structural lint finds patterns regex cannot, a behavioral nudge reacts when the agent's narration repeats the antipattern, and a final LLM gate handles ambiguous cases.

<!-- gd-embed: code_quality.py -->

**What to learn.** The same problem expressed at four escalating tiers, all firing on `Event.PostToolUse`. `hook(... Content(...))` runs a fast regex check on the edit, while `lint(...)` parses the file's AST so you can flag structures (bare except) that stay invisible to plain text. `nudge(... signals=...)` watches transcript narration to catch the agent talking about the antipattern, and `llm_gate(...)` lets a model adjudicate the ambiguous prod-print cases. Combine tiers when speed-vs-precision tradeoffs matter, and read ../guide/primitives.qmd and ../guide/llm-hooks.qmd for the full set.
